Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Creative Arts Academy provides a comprehensive range of dance, drama, and music instruction for students of all ages, emphasizing a supportive and inclusive environment. Our operations include regular classes in various styles such as ballet, jazz, hip-hop, and contemporary dance, along with acting and music courses aimed at fostering creativity and self-expression. We also host seasonal workshops, audition preparation sessions, and performance showcases that engage and inspire our diverse clientele. We prioritize safety and maintain strict protocols, including slip-resistant flooring, proper lighting, and secure equipment storage to minimize risks. All staff members are required to obtain professional certifications and undergo background checks to ensure a safe learning environment for minors.
